standby.note: Idle samples only; duration is not inferred from sample count because sampling may have been downsampled or interrupted. Includes unplugged periods if the charger reports a small non-zero draw while idle.

soc_based.note: SoC-based efficiency assumes the configured usable capacity and that reported SoC changes are proportional to stored energy. Treat it as a cross-check on the AC<->DC result, not as a precise measurement.

calibration.note: Effective capacity is DC energy per 100% of reported dashboard SoC in the linear mid-range, not a pack-capacity or degradation claim. The Leaf dashboard is nonlinear and keeps a few kWh in reserve at the bottom. Use this value for SoC-rate planning and keep the low-SoC reserve as a separate constraint.
